electric.notes: Focus rings, the active sidebar item, the identity square, the flow stripe. Never a fill.

ink.notes: Headings, tile names, field values, the selected tile border.

body.notes: Descriptions, field names, Label type, non-brand icons. Label type uses this, not Steel.

steel.notes: A line colour, not a text colour. Usage edges, ghost borders, hover borders. Measures 3.45:1 at 11px, below the floor for small text.

fog.notes: The one tinted surface: resource tiles, the sidebar, skeletons, hover fills.

paper.notes: The page, app tiles, chips, controls, panels.

hairline.notes: Every border, divider, table rule and panel edge. 1px, always.

grid.notes: Declared for parity with www; the console paints nothing with it.

go.notes: A succeeded outcome dot and the copied-confirmation check. Only where something actually succeeded.

destructive.notes: A failed outcome dot, the failure banner, an app's reported error. Never a solid fill on a button.

terminal.notes: The command pane's material, dark in both themes.

title.purpose: Page heading in the standard page shell.

headline.purpose: Heading inside a notice or a canvas empty state.

subject.purpose: Tile name, details-panel subject, related app or resource.

body.purpose: Document default. Descriptions, menu items, nav labels.

detail.purpose: Panel field rows, table cells, explanatory sentences.

label.purpose: Anything that names rather than says: section headings, table headers, chips, captions, the provenance stamp. Body colour, never Steel.

path.purpose: Literal strings the CLI reported: urls, keys, binding names, folders, files, errors. Keeps its own case.

command.purpose: The environment switcher and the command pane's prompt line.

motion.name: state-colors
motion.purpose: Border and text colour changes on hover and focus. The only state transition on a control.

motion.name: view-fit
motion.purpose: Fitting the service map to the viewport after a resize or a fit press.

motion.name: view-zoom
motion.purpose: Zoom in and out on the canvas.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: The mobile details sheet entering and leaving from the bottom edge.

motion.name: nav-enter
motion.purpose: The sidebar's scoped navigation group when project scope changes. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: wiggle
motion.purpose: A sidebar icon on hover, once, motion-safe only.

motion.name: flow
motion.value: 0.7s linear infinite, 16px repeating stripe in Electric
motion.purpose: An in-progress edge or bar. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the details panel becomes a bottom sheet and the map fits with a 0.75 zoom floor.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Side padding steps from 20px to 32px; the variables table reveals its folder column.

layout.name: dot-ground
layout.value: 2px dots in Steel at 55% on a 24px gap

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one electric fill in the console. Square, flat, nudges down 1px on press.

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Resource Tile
components.description: A provisioned resource. The tonal step to Fog is what separates it from an app at a glance.

components.name: Ghost Tile

narrative.overview:
The console is the same drawing as ocel.dev with the drafting apparatus lifted off. Paper ground, hairline rules, square corners, mono labels, one electric annotation. What the site does with grid paper, registration crosses and heavy rules, the console does with nothing at all: the reader's own infrastructure is the figure on the sheet, and the shell is there to hold it flat.

Density is the difference from the site. This is an operator's surface read at 14px, on an 8px-and-under rhythm, with a fixed 56px header rule, a resizable sidebar and pages that run to the viewport rather than to a prose column. Where the site pairs a grotesk with a humanist sans, the console runs Space Grotesk for everything that is set as text and IBM Plex Mono for everything the system names rather than says. There is no third reading face here.

The one place the apparatus returns is a canvas. The project overview is an infinite sheet with a faint dot ground, square hairline tiles laid out left-to-right, and dashed curves where an app reads a resource. It is a drawing of a deployment, stamped with when it was true, and it mutates nothing.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and hairlines only. Electric appears on focus rings, the active nav item and the identity square, nowhere else.
Zero radius, enforced by --radius: 0rem and explicit square variants on every primitive.
Depth by hairline and one tonal step to Fog. No shadow, no glow, no blur.
Mono uppercase Label type names every section, column, chip and stamp.
Canvases may carry a faint dot ground; no other surface carries any ground.
Every view of infrastructure carries its "as at" stamp in Label type.

rules.name: The One Annotation Rule
rules.body: Electric owns less than ten percent of any view. On the console it is a focus ring, the active nav item and the identity square. It never fills a tile, a panel, a banner or a status.

rules.name: The Outcome Colour Rule
rules.body: Go and Destructive report a record, never a mood. A 8px dot carries them on a tile; a ghost tile carries no dot at all, because a torn-down thing has no outcome to report.

rules.name: The Same Ink Rule
rules.body: The console and the site draw from one token set. A new token on the console is a new token on the site, so it earns its place in both records first.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Anything that names rather than says is Label type: mono, uppercase, 0.14em, Body colour. The carve-out is a literal string — a path, url, key, binding name or command — which is Path or Command type and keeps its case exactly as the CLI reported it.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Label type is set in Body colour, not Steel. Steel measures 3.45:1 at 11px, under the floor for text that size; Steel stays a line colour. Any new small-type role inherits Body, not Steel.

rules.name: The Real Text Rule
rules.body: Commands, slugs, urls, keys and grants are primary content. They are selectable text, never an image or a screenshot.

rules.name: The Quiet Shell Rule
rules.body: The console never shows the site's landing apparatus: no grid paper, no registration crosses, no rotated figure captions, no marquee, no heavy rules. The shell is paper, hairlines and type so the reader's infrastructure is the only thing on the sheet.

rules.name: The Canvas Dot Rule
rules.body: A canvas, and only a canvas, may carry a dot ground: 1px dots in Grid on a 24px gap. Every state of that canvas carries the same ground, so the empty, error and loading screens sit on the same sheet as the map. No other surface in the console has a ground of any kind.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, glows, or blurs what is behind it. A surface that needs to separate gets a hairline or steps to Fog.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: One step only, and it carries meaning: an app tile is Paper, a resource tile is Fog. The map reads as two materials — the things you wrote and the things they read — before a single word is read.

dos: Do keep every corner square. --radius: 0rem is the invariant, and each primitive restates it so a library component cannot arrive rounded.
Do set every label, table header, chip, caption and stamp in mono uppercase 11px at 0.14em in Body colour.
Do keep literal strings — paths, urls, keys, binding names, commands — in mono at their own case, exactly as the CLI reported them.
Do make the tonal step carry meaning: app tiles Paper, resource tiles Fog.
Do step a border rather than lift a surface: hairline at rest, Steel on hover, Ink when selected.
Do draw relationships as dashed 1.5px Steel beziers at 60% with no arrowheads, going solid Ink only when active.
Do stamp every infrastructure view with its "as at" moment and the promotion it came from.
Do name the command in a dark command pane wherever the console cannot act.
Do confine the dot ground to canvases, and give every state of a canvas the same ground.
donts: Don't let Electric fill a tile, panel, banner, chip or status. Focus ring, active nav item and identity square only.
Don't add shadows, glows, blurs or gradients. Overlays use a flat 10% black scrim.
Don't bring the site's landing apparatus here: no grid paper, no registration crosses, no rotated figure captions, no marquee, no 1.5px rules.
Don't set Label type in Steel. It fails contrast at 11px; Steel is a line colour.
Don't put an outcome dot on a ghost tile, or a status colour on anything that has not actually reported one.
Don't introduce a second accent, a chart palette, or a third typeface. Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono, and Archivo for the wordmark are the whole set.
Don't stand in for a brand mark with a letter, an emoji or a coloured square.
Don't render a command, url or record as an image.
